title: Crispy Pork Ribs in Chinese BBQ Sauce
description: A twist on traditional Chinese BBQ, these crispy pork ribs are smothered in a sweet and savory sauce.
instructions: In a shallow dish, mix together flour, cornstarch, and a pinch of salt.
Toss pork ribs in flour mixture to coat.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear pork ribs until browned, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer pork ribs to a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
While ribs are roasting, combine brown sugar, soy sauce, rice vinegar, garlic, and ginger in a saucepan.
Bring sauce to a boil over medium heat, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Remove ribs from oven and brush with BBQ sauce.
Return ribs to oven and roast for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until caramelized.
Let ribs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
